question: How does ANZ define the population used for its Women in Leadership measure, including which role groups and worker types are included or excluded?
answer: Women as a proportion of the entire Senior Manager, Executive, Senior Executive and Group Executive Committee populations (ANZ Groups 3, 2 and 1); all employees are included regardless of leave status, while contractors are excluded from the WIL measure even though included in FTE.
subject: ANZ Group Holdings Limited
scope_boundary: Senior Manager, Executive, Senior Executive and Group Executive Committee populations; employees including leave status; contractors excluded

evidence.verbatim_excerpt: Includes all employees regardless of leave status but not contractors (which are included in FTE).
